steps.name: Record setup start
steps.run: echo "BEEP_SETUP_STARTED_AT=$(date +%s)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Detect baked runner
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
hit=false
# Never trust a writable cache inherited from the image or an earlier
# step. A valid baked image restores it from the authenticated archive.
rm -rf -- "${HOME:?}/.bun/install/cache"
if [ -f /etc/beep-ci/baked-runner ] \
  && [ -f /etc/beep-ci/bun-lock.sha256 ] \
  && [ -f /etc/beep-ci/bun-version ] \
  && [ -f /etc/beep-ci/bun-archive.sha256 ] \
  && [ -f /etc/beep-ci/bun-binary.sha256 ] \
  && [ -f /etc/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.sha256 ] \
  && [ -x /usr/local/bin/bun ] \
  && [ -L /usr/local/bin/bunx ] \
  && [ -f /opt/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.tgz ]; then
  baked_lock="$(cat /etc/beep-ci/bun-lock.sha256)"
  checkout_lock="$(sha256sum bun.lock | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  baked_bun="$(cat /etc/beep-ci/bun-version)"
  checkout_bun="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .bun-version)"
  baked_archive="$(cat /etc/beep-ci/bun-archive.sha256)"
  checkout_archive="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .bun-linux-x64.sha256)"
  baked_binary="$(cat /etc/beep-ci/bun-binary.sha256)"
  installed_binary="$(sha256sum /usr/local/bin/bun | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  baked_cache="$(cat /etc/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.sha256)"
  installed_cache="$(sha256sum /opt/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.tgz | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  bun_owner_mode="$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /usr/local/bin/bun)"
  cache_owner_mode="$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /opt/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.tgz)"
  bunx_target="$(readlink /usr/local/bin/bunx)"
  if [ "$baked_lock" = "$checkout_lock" ] \
    && [ "$baked_bun" = "$checkout_bun" ] \
    && [ "$baked_archive" = "$checkout_archive" ] \
    && [ "$baked_binary" = "$installed_binary" ] \
    && [ "$baked_cache" = "$installed_cache" ] \
    && [ "$bun_owner_mode" = "0:0:755" ] \
    && [ "$cache_owner_mode" = "0:0:444" ] \
    && [ "$bunx_target" = "bun" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$HOME/.bun/install"
    tar -xzf /opt/beep-ci/bun-install-cache.tgz -C "$HOME/.bun/install"
    hit=true
    echo "/usr/local/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    echo "baked runner fast path: bun $baked_bun, binary $baked_binary, lockfile $baked_lock, archive $baked_archive, cache $baked_cache"
  else
    echo "baked runner stale or failed integrity checks; using full setup"
  fi
fi
echo "hit=$hit" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

finished_at="$(date +%s)"
setup_seconds="n/a"

  echo "| Bun cache key | \`bun-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('bun.lock') }}\` |"

  echo "| Turbo cache key | \`turbo-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.job }}${{ inputs.turbo-cache-key-suffix }}-${{ hashFiles('turbo.json', 'package.json', 'bun.lock') }}\` |"

steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
should_run=true
eval "$(scripts/ci-change-profile.sh "origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}")"
if [[ "$goals_only" == "true" ]]; then

  base_ref="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}"

    git fetch --quiet --no-tags --depth=100 origin "${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}:refs/remotes/origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}"
  fi
  changed_files="$(git diff --name-only "${base_ref}...HEAD")"
  # Root dependency resolution changes the resolved generator or formatter, so these files are drift inputs.
  if ! grep -Eq '(^packages/drivers/(acp|ecfr|govinfo|runpod)/(openapi[^/]*\.json|spec/|scripts/|src/_generated/)|^packages/tooling/library/codegen-kit/|^packages/tooling/tool/cli/src/commands/Ci/CiLane\.ts$|^packages/_internal/db-admin/drizzle/|^apps/professional-desktop/(package\.json|scripts/sync-migration-bundle\.ts|src/runtime/Migrations\.gen\.ts)$|^(package\.json|bun\.lock)$)' <<< "$changed_files"; then
    should_run=false
  fi

# only fire for direct labs-path or shared-toolchain changes; push
# events always run the full labs set.
if [[ "${{ matrix.id }}" == "labs" && "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
  base_ref="origin/${GITHUB_BASE_REF:-main}"

  fi

steps.name: Run verification lane
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Lane bodies live in the beep CLI (one-round-loop P0 inversion;
# same-SHA parity proof recorded in
# goals/one-round-loop/history/p0-parity-evidence.md). This case
# block carries only GitHub-context orchestration: the
# event-dependent shape flags each lane receives.
#
# Orphaned lane grandchildren (stuck bun wrappers, daemon sockets)
# inherit this step's stdio pipes, and the runner does not end a
# step until those pipes close — so a lane can print success, exit,
# and still wedge the job for its full timeout (ship-velocity SPEC
# A7; proven on Docgen run 31797064763). Run each lane in its own
# session and reap the entire process group once the lane process
# finishes, success and failure alike.
run_lane() {
  setsid bun run beep "$@" < /dev/null &
  local pgid=$!
  local status=0
  wait "$pgid" || status=$?
  kill -TERM -- "-$pgid" 2>/dev/null || true
  sleep 2
  kill -KILL -- "-$pgid" 2>/dev/null || true
  return "$status"
}

steps.name: Check dependency graph availability
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Security property (CSF-022): never silently FAIL OPEN on a
# transient/attacker-induced gh-api error. The real attack vector is an
# unreachable or failing API call, so an actual `gh api` COMMAND failure
# (non-zero exit) fails CLOSED below.
#
# We capture the gh exit code explicitly instead of letting `set -e`
# abort, so we can distinguish a genuine api failure (fail closed) from
# a benign condition where the api SUCCEEDS but the
# security_and_analysis.dependency_graph.status field is absent — e.g.
# the GITHUB_TOKEN lacks permission to read it, or the feature config is
# not exposed. That benign case must NOT hard-fail; the
# dependency-review action that runs afterward is the real gate.
set +e
status="$(
  gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
    --jq '.security_and_analysis.dependency_graph.status // "unavailable"'
)"
gh_exit=$?
set -e

if [ "$gh_exit" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::gh api call to read dependency graph status failed (exit ${gh_exit}); failing closed instead of skipping the dependency review gate."
  exit 1
fi

case "$status" in
  enabled)
    echo "enabled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    ;;
  disabled)
    echo "enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    echo "::notice::Skipping dependency review because GitHub dependency graph is explicitly disabled for this repository."
    ;;
  *)
    # api ok but status absent/unavailable: benign token-permission or
    # feature-config condition (the CI token cannot read
    # security_and_analysis, or the feature config is not exposed). The
    # actions/dependency-review-action HARD-FAILS when dependency graph
    # is not actually enabled for the repo, so running it here would fail
    # on a non-finding condition rather than perform a real review.
    # SKIP it instead (fail open on undetectable availability); a genuine
    # gh api COMMAND failure still fails closed above, and OSV scanning
    # continues to cover dependency vulnerabilities. Enable Dependency
    # graph in repo Settings -> Security & analysis to activate this gate.
    echo "enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    echo "::warning::Dependency graph status could not be determined (got '${status:-unavailable}'); skipping the dependency-review gate (OSV still covers dependency vulns). Enable Dependency graph in repo settings to activate it."
    ;;
esac

steps.name: Probe M - JIT configuration replay
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
scratch_runner="${RUNNER_TEMP}/jit-replay-runner"
listener_log="${RUNNER_TEMP}/jit-replay-listener.log"
trap 'unset jit_value; rm -rf -- "${scratch_runner}"' EXIT
mkdir -p "${scratch_runner}"
cp -a /opt/actions-runner/bin "${scratch_runner}/bin"
cp -a /opt/actions-runner/externals "${scratch_runner}/externals"
(cd "${scratch_runner}" && "${scratch_runner}/bin/Runner.Listener" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

jit_value="$(
  for f in /proc/[0-9]*/cmdline; do
    tr '\0' ' ' < "$f" 2>/dev/null
  done | grep -o -- '--jitconfig [A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]*' \
    | grep -E '^--jitconfig [A-Za-z0-9+/=_-]+$' | head -1 || true
)"
jit_value="${jit_value#--jitconfig }"
if [[ -z "${jit_value}" ]]; then
  echo "JIT replay: inconclusive (running listener configuration was not readable)"
  exit 1
fi

replay_runner_name="$(
  printf '%s' "${jit_value}" | python3 -c '
import base64, json, re, sys
encoded = sys.stdin.read().strip()
encoded += "=" * (-len(encoded) % 4)
try:
    payload = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(encoded))
except Exception:
    payload = {}
runner = payload.get("runner")
name = runner.get("name") if isinstance(runner, dict) else None
name = name if isinstance(name, str) else payload.get("agentName")
if isinstance(name, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}", name):
    print(name)
' || true
)"

set +e
(cd "${scratch_runner}" && timeout 90 "${scratch_runner}/bin/Runner.Listener" run \
  --jitconfig "${jit_value}" > "${listener_log}" 2>&1)
listener_status=$?
set -e

# Only a recognized server-side rejection marker may classify the replay as rejected.
# A marker-free non-zero exit is a local setup or runtime failure and must stay
# inconclusive, or the gate reports PASS without evidence GitHub rejected the replay.
# Markers are case-sensitive and phrase-anchored so a local diagnostic that merely
# contains a keyword (for example a missing shared library reported as "not found")
# cannot pass as a server-side rejection; an unanticipated rejection phrase fails
# inconclusive, which is the safe direction for this gate.
error_line="$(grep -Em1 \
  -e 'already (been )?(registered|used|configured|exists)' \
  -e '[Ii]nvalid (JIT|jit|runner) ?(config|configuration|token)' \
  -e '(token|configuration|JIT config|jitconfig) (has )?expired' \
  -e '\bUnauthorized\b' \
  -e '[Rr]unner (was )?not found' \
  -e '(access|permission) denied' \
  "${listener_log}" | tr -d '\r' || true)"
diag_line=""
if [[ -z "${error_line}" && "${listener_status}" -ne 0 && "${listener_status}" -ne 124 ]]; then
  diag_line="$(sed -n '/[^[:space:]]/{s/\r$//;p;q;}' "${listener_log}")"
  diag_line="${diag_line:-no listener output}"
  diag_line="${diag_line//${jit_value}/[redacted]}"
  diag_line="$(printf '%s' "${diag_line}" | sed -E \
    's/--jitconfig[ =]+[A-Za-z0-9+\/_=-]+/--jitconfig [redacted]/g' | cut -c1-240)"
fi
if [[ -n "${error_line}" ]]; then
  error_line="${error_line//${jit_value}/[redacted]}"
  error_line="$(printf '%s' "${error_line}" | sed -E \
    's/--jitconfig[ =]+[A-Za-z0-9+\/_=-]+/--jitconfig [redacted]/g' | cut -c1-240)"
  unset jit_value
  echo "JIT replay: rejected (${error_line})"
  exit 0
fi

unset jit_value
if grep -Eq 'Listening for Jobs|Connected to GitHub' "${listener_log}" || [[ "${listener_status}" -eq 124 ]]; then
  echo "JIT replay: accepted"
  [[ -z "${replay_runner_name}" ]] || echo "JIT replay runner: ${replay_runner_name}"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -n "${diag_line}" ]]; then
  echo "JIT replay: inconclusive (listener exited with status ${listener_status}: ${diag_line})"
  exit 1
fi

echo "JIT replay: inconclusive (listener exited without a rejection or connection marker)"
exit 1

steps.name: Run verification lane
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# Lane bodies live in the beep CLI (one-round-loop P0 inversion;
# same-SHA parity proof recorded in
# goals/one-round-loop/history/p0-parity-evidence.md). This case
# block carries only GitHub-context orchestration: the
# event-dependent shape flags each lane receives.
#
# Orphaned lane grandchildren (stuck bun wrappers, daemon sockets)
# inherit this step's stdio pipes, and the runner does not end a
# step until those pipes close — so a lane can print success, exit,
# and still wedge the job for its full timeout (ship-velocity SPEC
# A7; proven on Docgen run 31797064763). Run each lane in its own
# session and reap the entire process group once the lane process
# finishes, success and failure alike.
run_lane() {
  setsid bun run beep "$@" < /dev/null &
  local pgid=$!
  local status=0
  wait "$pgid" || status=$?
  kill -TERM -- "-$pgid" 2>/dev/null || true
  sleep 2
  kill -KILL -- "-$pgid" 2>/dev/null || true
  return "$status"
}

while IFS=$'\t' read -r asset_id asset_name; do
  if [[ -z "${asset_id}" ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  echo "Deleting stale draft asset ${asset_name}."
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/assets/${asset_id}" >/dev/null
done < <(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${release_id}/assets?per_page=100" --paginate --jq '.[] | [.id, .name] | @tsv')

while IFS= read -r asset_name; do
  asset_file="$(find "${artifact_root}" -type f -name "${asset_name}" -print -quit)"
  if [[ -z "${asset_file}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Expected desktop asset ${asset_name} is missing from downloaded artifacts."
    exit 1
  fi
  gh release upload "${RELEASE_DESKTOP_TAG}" "${asset_file}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --clobber
done < "${expected_assets}"

release_assets="${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-release-assets.jsonl"
gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${release_id}/assets?per_page=100" \
  --paginate \
  --jq '.[] | {name, browser_download_url}' > "${release_assets}"

uploaded_assets="${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-uploaded-assets.txt"
jq -r '.name' "${release_assets}" | sort > "${uploaded_assets}"
comm -23 "${expected_assets}" "${uploaded_assets}" | sed 's/^/missing asset: /' > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-missing-assets.txt"
if [[ -s "${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-missing-assets.txt" ]]; then
  cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-missing-assets.txt"
  echo "::error::Draft release is missing one or more matrix-declared assets."
  exit 1
fi

latest_json="${RUNNER_TEMP}/latest.json"
app_version="$(jq -r '.version' apps/professional-desktop/package.json)"
jq -n \
  --arg version "${app_version}" \
  --arg notes "Professional Desktop ${RELEASE_DESKTOP_TAG}" \
  '{ version: $version, notes: $notes, pub_date: (now | todateiso8601), platforms: {} }' > "${latest_json}"

for manifest in "${manifests[@]}"; do
  platform="$(jq -r '.updaterPlatform' "${manifest}")"
  updater_asset="$(jq -r '.updaterAsset' "${manifest}")"
  signature_asset="$(jq -r '.signatureAsset' "${manifest}")"
  updater_url="$(jq -r --arg name "${updater_asset}" 'select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url' "${release_assets}" | head -n 1)"
  signature_file="$(find "${artifact_root}" -type f -name "${signature_asset}" -print -quit)"

  if [[ -z "${updater_url}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Matrix platform ${platform} references updater asset ${updater_asset}, which was not uploaded."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ -z "${signature_file}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Matrix platform ${platform} references signature asset ${signature_asset}, which is missing from artifacts."
    exit 1
  fi

  signature="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "${signature_file}")"
  if [[ -z "${signature}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Signature asset ${signature_asset} for ${platform} is empty."
    exit 1
  fi

  tmp_latest="${latest_json}.tmp"
  jq \
    --arg platform "${platform}" \
    --arg url "${updater_url}" \
    --arg signature "${signature}" \
    '.platforms[$platform] = { signature: $signature, url: $url }' \
    "${latest_json}" > "${tmp_latest}"
  mv "${tmp_latest}" "${latest_json}"
done

actual_platforms="${RUNNER_TEMP}/desktop-actual-platforms.txt"
jq -r '.platforms | keys[]' "${latest_json}" | sort > "${actual_platforms}"
if ! diff -u "${expected_platforms}" "${actual_platforms}"; then
  echo "::error::latest.json platform keys do not match the matrix manifests."
  exit 1
fi

for manifest in "${manifests[@]}"; do
  platform="$(jq -r '.updaterPlatform' "${manifest}")"
  updater_asset="$(jq -r '.updaterAsset' "${manifest}")"
  signature_asset="$(jq -r '.signatureAsset' "${manifest}")"
  expected_url="$(jq -r --arg name "${updater_asset}" 'select(.name == $name) | .browser_download_url' "${release_assets}" | head -n 1)"
  actual_url="$(jq -r --arg platform "${platform}" '.platforms[$platform].url' "${latest_json}")"
  expected_signature="$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$(find "${artifact_root}" -type f -name "${signature_asset}" -print -quit)")"
  actual_signature="$(jq -r --arg platform "${platform}" '.platforms[$platform].signature' "${latest_json}")"

  if [[ "${actual_url}" != "${expected_url}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::latest.json URL for ${platform} does not match uploaded asset ${updater_asset}."
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "${actual_signature}" != "${expected_signature}" ]]; then
    echo "::error::latest.json signature for ${platform} does not match ${signature_asset}."
    exit 1
  fi
done

gh release upload "${RELEASE_DESKTOP_TAG}" "${latest_json}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --clobber
gh release view "${RELEASE_DESKTOP_TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json assets,isDraft \
  --jq 'select(.isDraft == true) | .assets[].name' | grep -Fx latest.json >/dev/null
echo "::notice::Draft release ${RELEASE_DESKTOP_TAG} contains all matrix-declared assets and a complete latest.json."
